recipe.visualDefinition: A studio portrait of three women in denim and casual wear against a textured blue-grey backdrop, featuring prominent retro-styled script typography and a floral accent bar at the bottom.
coreVisualRelationships: The subjects are physically connected through overlapping poses to convey unity.
The typography overlaps the subjects to integrate the text into the scene.
The blue roses at the bottom anchor the composition and mirror the background color.
coreInvariants: Denim-centric wardrobe in varying shades of blue
Soft, even lighting with minimal harsh shadows

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: Three subjects centered, waist-up framing, occupying the middle two-thirds of the vertical space.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The large, stylized script text in the lower half of the frame.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: Starts at the faces of the subjects, moves down through the large script, and rests on the floral horizontal bar.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: Ample space at the top and sides to allow the subjects to breathe against the textured wall.

colorSystem.dominantColorRole: Steel blue and denim tones provide the primary atmospheric color.
colorSystem.contrastColorRole: Cream/off-white used for the main typography to pop against the blue.
colorSystem.accentColorRole: Dark navy outlines on text and purple-blue hues in the roses.
colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: Desaturated background allows the natural skin tones and hair colors of the subjects to stand out.
paletteRestrictions: Limit to cool blues, creams, and natural tones

typographyAndGraphicLanguage.baseSkeleton: Mid-century casual script with upright, rhythmic loops.
letterConstructionRules: Thick dark navy drop-shadow/offset outline for depth
Exaggerated descenders and ascenders that weave through the composition
characterSpecificRedesigns: The 'J' and 'R' feature large, sweeping loops that frame the other letters.
typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: A fluid, organic script paired with a rigid, geometric slab serif for structural contrast.
graphicDevices: Watercolor-style blue rose illustrations framing the banner

candidateDirections.reason: Similar rhythmic flow and weight contrast.
Matches the heavy, wide slab serif used for the subtitle.

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: Generate a studio portrait of three smiling women in denim clothing, posed closely together against a textured blue-grey wall. Leave the bottom third of the image relatively clear for text overlays.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Add large, cream-colored custom script lettering with a navy blue offset outline across the center-bottom. Below that, place a horizontal cream bar decorated with watercolor blue roses, containing a wide-spaced navy slab serif subtitle.

verificationChecks: Text is legible against the subjects.
The blue roses match the tonal range of the background.
The script lettering feels integrated, not just pasted on top.
The subjects' expressions are warm and approachable.

adjustableVariables: Flower species in the bottom bar
mustRedesign: Specific facial features of the original subjects
Unique hand-drawn flourishes of the original lettering
postGenerationChecks: Ensure the cream color of the text is consistent throughout.
Check that the floral elements do not obscure the subtitle text.
Verify the textured wall doesn't look like digital noise.
Confirm the trio's posing looks natural and unified.
recipe.reuseFormula: Studio Portrait + Denim Wardrobe + Textured Blue Backdrop + Retro Script Overlay + Floral Anchor Bar
